summary: The Arizona Backcountry Discovery Route runs 750 miles from the Mexico border to the Utah border in 4-6 days. Difficulty: Difficult (per ridebdr.com). Best time: May, June, September, October. Permits (Mar 2026): AZ State Land Trust Recreation Permit ($15 individual), CO Bar Ranch permit (free, Section 5), Navajo Nation permit ($25/person, Sections 5 & 6). No OHV permit needed for a licensed/plated street-legal motorcycle. Link-only per BDR terms — get the free GPX at ridebdr.com.
